hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook that runs a permissionless per-pool buyback pot: after each swap, the pot uses donated secondary-token funds to buy the pool's main asset and deliver it to a configured recipient (default: burn). Also supports an optional auto-compounding LP fee program with configurable splits between compounding, pot refuel, burn, and a custom recipient.
